title: Double-clicking a track group's name renames it without folding it
goal: Find out whether double-clicking a track group's name on the timeline, to rename it, also folds the group and opens it again under the pointer, and stop it if so. The name of a group is both the fold button and the place you double-click to rename, so each of the two clicks may count as a fold.
notes: Sources/Photonz/TimelineTrackRows.swift ~1094-1112: the group header is a Button whose action is toggleTrackGroupCollapsed, with a simultaneousGesture TapGesture(count: 2) for rename. A plain Button fires once per click, so a double-click likely toggles twice. Read in the code by the 2026-10-05 22:xx manager pass, not seen on screen, hence p2 and the reproduce step. A track's own name renames on double-click without this problem (~167-170).
acceptance: Reproduce first: at Next defaults, open a recording, add a second video track, right-click a track header > Group Track, then double-click the group's name. Write in the log whether the tracks below fold and unfold (a filmed walk or two pictures), and whether the group ends folded or open
If it does: a double-click on the group's name only starts renaming, and the group stays as it was; a single click still folds and unfolds it, as the chevron says
If it does not: the log says so with the evidence, and the task closes with no change

A walk at Next defaults double-clicks a group's name and checks the group is still open and the name field is up. Audit written under queue/audits/ if the app changed; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults (no flags): Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/group-dblclick-repro.json (V2 added, V2+V1 grouped, then press 'Track group Group 1' count 2 = two real clicks, AppKit click counts 1 and 2). Panel after: only 'Track group Group 1' and 'Track Audio', V2 and V1 gone, no name field. Pictures: before shows Group 1 open with V2/V1, after shows '> Group 1' folded to one row. A temporary log in toggleTrackGroupCollapsed printed exactly ONE toggle (clickCount=1, wasCollapsed=false): the first click folds, and the second click neither folds again nor renames, because the simultaneous TapGesture(count: 2) never fires on the Button. So it is worse than the task guessed: the group ends FOLDED and double-click rename does not work at all. Only the right-click Rename… reaches the field.

Fix: the group heading is now two buttons. The chevron (walk name 'Track group X', as before) folds at once. The name ('Group name X') reads AppKit's click count like a track's name does: a double-click starts renaming, and a single click folds after NSEvent.doubleClickInterval, cancelled by a second click, so a double-click never folds. Chose the wait over fold-then-unfold because the task asks for the group to stay as it was, and the chevron gives an instant fold. The removed TapGesture(count: 2) never fired beside the Button. The name field also got the track field's async focus and commit-on-blur, and renameTrackGroup skips a no-change rename. Verified: group-name-double-click-renames-walk green at defaults (open + folded double-click, name single click, chevron), tracks-you-can-add-rename-group-walk green, Scripts/test.sh 11436 passed. Nothing left rough earns a follow-up.

Reproduced: a double-click on a group's name folded the group and never opened the name (two pictures, one fold logged). Fixed in TimelineTrackRows: the chevron folds at once, a double-click on the name only renames, and a single click on the name folds after the double-click time. Verified by group-name-double-click-renames-walk at Next defaults, tracks-you-can-add-rename-group-walk, Scripts/test.sh (11436 passed).
